items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 14:1
items.html: Three Partzufim emerged in Nekudim, which are: AVI in four levels, whose bodies are: Da'at, Hesed, Gevura, and the upper third of Tifferet, down to the Chazeh. The second Partzuf is Yeshsut in four levels, whose bodies are: the lower two thirds of Tifferet, Netzah-Hod, Yesod, and Malchut. The third is the coupling of the two crowns in Da'at, which emerged as a Rosh without a Guf. (p. 513, Item 39. And in the Inner Light, Sub Header, “The Seven Kings.” And p. 545, Item 73. And in the Inner Light there.)
